companies.name: Anthropic
companies.reason: Anthropic, an artificial intelligence firm behind the chatbot Claude, has confidentially submitted a filing to the SEC to go public. Upon approval, this would set up one of the biggest initial public offerings (IPOs) in history. The firm is receiving significant attention because it's an AI company that's competing and racing with other giants in the AI revolution like OpenAI, not to mention it's backed by Alphabet, which owns around 14% of Anthropic.

companies.name: Nvidia
companies.reason: Nvidia has made major announcements at Computex 2026, revealing its new RTX Spark chip. The RTX Spark is being touted as “the most efficient PC chip ever built”. This new chip is set to eventually power new computers, bringing a high level of efficiency and processing power, set to shake up the CPU wars and rescue Windows on Arm gaming. Notably, this chip has been developed in collaboration with MediaTek and is expected to debut this fall in laptops from Dell, HP, Lenovo, and others.
